static_traits.name: Chen Shan
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide in, but not yet discussed this specific problem with anyone
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without prior psychotherapy history; such problems have not yet occurred before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, capable of self-Reflection, calm tone, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: At work I am often distracted by thinking about games, worrying about making mistakes because of it and being fired.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because distraction has begun to affect my work performance and I fear losing my job because of it.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough (prone to messing up Work)
Mistakes at work will lead to serious consequences (being fired)

special_situations.event: When there are many work tasks and the workload increases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I get distracted or make a mistake under high pressure, I will be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to control distraction by making to-do lists and limiting gaming time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might mess up at work and get fired

special_situations.event: Sees one's performance declining, misses some deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once performance declines it means I am not competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes up by working overtime to avoid worse consequences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Attracted by game-related thoughts while working on an important project
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not relax with games immediately, I will be unable to bear the pressure; but Distraction will lead to Work failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using self-comfort (can make up for it later) to allow brief distraction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must relax through games now, otherwise the tasks will not get done

special_situations.event: Despite not having received any formal warning, only reminded to be more focused
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as any performance problem appears, I will sooner or later be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continued worrying, strengthening Self-monitoring to try to avoid mistakes

core_conflict.wish: Longs to relieve work stress through relaxation (gaming) and maintain a sense of control
core_conflict.fear: Fears being punished/fired for distraction and mistakes, losing safety and stability
defense_goal: Maintaining safety and control through self-restraint and remedy (limiting gaming, time management, overtime work)

object_relations.self_representation: An easily distracted employee who worries about failing
object_relations.object_representation: Supervisors and colleagues who may punish/judge oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When work tasks surge and pressure is felt
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding pressure as a signal that 'if not relieved immediately, I will fail and be fired'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes in a defensive tone that 'games let me relax and I can make it up later', downplaying the impact of distraction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks for evidence or the worst case
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views conversation as needing reason to prove I can control risk, weakening emotion
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objective, analytical language to list supporting and opposing evidence, reducing emotional expression.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When worried about being evaluated by the manager or reminded to focus
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Regarding the supervisor as a potential punisher, feeling I may fail at any time
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Displacing attention to game-related imagination, temporarily avoiding direct feeling and expression of Work pressure.

manifestations: Under work pressure, longing to use games to relax and escape, with a conflict of choice arising against professional responsibilities
Worrying about losing the life freedom and security that Work brings

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: During work tasks, uses game-related fantasies to avoid facing pressure and the need to concentrate
When talking about stress, first turns to 'how to relax' rather than directly experiencing current emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently worrying about mistakes and being fired
Excessive monitoring and reproach of self-focus and performance

exception_events.target_problem: When work tasks are heavy, the client usually gets distracted by thinking about games, leading to decreased performance and worrying about being fired.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Yesterday on a big project, despite being Distracted by game-related thoughts midway, the client still completed the Work through overtime, and has not received a formal warning yet; the supervisor only reminded them to be more focused.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: using a to-do list and reminding oneself to focus; different situation: completing the task through delayed overtime; different support: not yet formally warned, external feedback relatively neutral.

positive_force: Willing to seek professional help, positive attitude
Has tried time management and setting gaming boundaries
Able to identify pressure trigger points (Distraction intensifies when tasks are many)
Relationship with colleagues and supervisor still okay (not yet received a formal warning)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and predicting the future (fearing being fired)
Escaping through gaming under pressure, causing distraction

target_behavior.behavior: Distracted at work by thoughts of games
antecedent: Many work tasks and increased workload
Carrying out important projects or tasks requiring high concentration
target_behavior.core_reason: Viewing games as a quick way to relax and escape pressure; catastrophic cognition of 'making mistakes will get me fired' Reinforces the Distraction tendency
target_behavior.function: Short-term escape from discomfort and pressure, gaining relaxation and pleasure
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, missing some deadlines, Anxiety worsened and worrying about being fired, needing overtime to remedy
